envelope.description: Template review in the controller review tool

body.title: Template review in the controller review tool
body.summary: For a design stage, insrc_review_step's start returns the template prompt with next emit_findings, and a new findings phase validates the answer with the same code as the session path and stamps the review. Add the phase to every place the phase list is declared: the tool registration and input validation, the phase type, the dispatch, and the test that pins the list. Other stages keep start, claims, verdicts.
acceptanceChecks: On a design, start returns emit_findings and the findings phase stamps the review
An answer the session path's validation rejects is rejected by the findings phase with the same errors, and nothing is stamped
On a DEF, start still returns the extract prompt and the claims and verdicts phases work as before
The registered tool accepts phase `findings` and its phase list names it

tests.name: T13 start and findings on a design; start, claims and verdicts on a DEF; the registered tool accepts phase findings
the schema-registry test lists findings among the review tool's phases
